test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ______ of directors will decide the penalty.
solution:
The correct answer is **Board**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The "**board**" refers to **a group of people** who **take important decisions** on behalf of a particular organisation or thing.
 
• The complete sentence will be “**The board of directors will decide the penalty**.
 
• One other **example** is: *The hospital formed a board of doctors to discuss the patient's condition.​*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **“Bowed”** means to **bend one’s head in front of a respected person**.

 
 
• **Example-** *The soldiers bowed down in front of the king.*
 
 
 
• **“Braid”** refers **to the thread of hair or wool or any other thread woven decoratively.**
 
 
• **Example-** *The coat looks gorgeous with the silk braid.*
 
 
 
• “**Bored**” refers to **the feeling of annoyance or impatience due to some uninteresting event**.
 
 
• **Example-** *His lecture did nothing but bore me to death.*
